title: Paley–Zygmund inequality for a finite distribution
statement:
Let $\Omega$ be a finite set, let $p$ be a probability mass function on $\Omega$, and let $Y:\Omega\to\mathbb{R}$ be nonnegative. For any $\theta\in[0,1)$, the following inequality holds:
\[(1-\theta)^2\bigl(\mathbb{E}_p Y\bigr)^2\leq \mathbb{P}_p\bigl(Y>\theta\,\mathbb{E}_pY\bigr)\,\mathbb{E}_p(Y^2).\]
hypotheses_covered: $p$ is a probability mass function on $\Omega$
